WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
), total_rows AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cnt
  FROM Examination
), with_shares AS (
  SELECT gc.ID, gc.cnt, CAST(gc.cnt AS FLOAT) / tr.total_cnt as share
  FROM group_counts gc
  CROSS JOIN total_rows tr
), mean_share_cte AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as mean_val
  FROM with_shares
), kept_groups AS (
  SELECT ws.ID, ws.cnt, ws.share
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN mean_share_cte ms
  WHERE ws.share > ms.mean_val
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_exam_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share) - (SELECT mean_val FROM mean_share_cte) as avg_diff_from_mean
FROM kept_groups
